project.title: Community structure of raw wastewater from a seafood processing facility
project.description: We examined the community structure of raw wastewater from a seafood processing facility primarily handling skipjack tuna, treated with a microalgae-bacteria consortium derived from the facility.
project.center_name: Applied Chemistry and Life Science, Toyohashi University of Technology
